title: The Dub Pistols dropped their highly anticipated track "Soundboy Killa"
htmlContent:
Fast-rising music band, The Dub Pistols has set the pace in taking their career to the top of their niche. The genesis of the Dub Pistols began when former club promoter and Deja Vu singer Barry Ashworth started DJing in the mid-90s. The Dub Pistols do not disappoint in their recent track "Soundboy Killa" feat. Natty Campbell. 

The Dub Pistols featuring Natty Campbell on their recent song "Soundboy Killa" allows their high-energy signature flows to shine more than ever. This notorious touring band carries the summer atmosphere into these winter months with their infamous blend of dub, hip-hop, ska, and jungle.
